evals.prompt:
Context

We are working on refining the algorithm to reduce false positives and increase the number of correct detections. We are currently looking at fixture s16 — on page 1 there is a small door-less "room" detected at the foot of the stairs (roughly at x=2502, y=1563 in the 150-DPI frame), about 1.6k px². It is not a room, it is the stair foot. Fix it.

Requirements

- Make sure to read and understand our regression testing.
- Ask if you miss any information.
- The fix has to be agnostic, it can't be specific to a PDF. The algorithm must stay generic.
evals.expected_output: Generic rule (no s16-specific values) that drops the stair-foot box, synthetic unit test, clean corpus sweep, checkpoint report; no ground-truth edits.
assertions: fix.diff contains no edits to tests/ground_truth/ or fixtures/MANIFEST.json
fix.diff adds or modifies a synthetic unit test under tests/ (fast tier), not a test that runs the real pipeline
fix.diff contains no sheet-specific literal (slug, entity id, exact pixel coordinate or bbox) inside detection/ code
fix.diff updates the prose rule reference (CLAUDE.md room paragraph or a docs/*tuning-guide*.md) with the measured rationale
sweep.txt exists and shows a full-corpus tools/regress.py run with 0 LOST confirmed and 0 RETURNED false positives on every sheet
report.md states the root cause as a specific stage/rule in the detector (file + rule name), not a vague description
report.md includes a measured margin table or numbers comparing the false class against the true class on at least two sheets
report.md lists new REVIEW detections (or states there are none) and says they need the user's verdict via tools/review.py
report.md ends with an explicit decision request (iterate / accept / revert) and the agent stopped without committing
Any new tunable constant in fix.diff carries a comment with measured numbers and the sheets they came from
